stemMd: What is the effect of Mrs. Imani's slower pace on the narrator?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It makes the narrator leave exactly at noon as usual.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It gives the narrator time to learn differences among plants and notice their needs.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It causes Ben to withdraw the volunteer certificate.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It prevents the narrator from learning any plant names.

explanationMd: The slow process includes observation and stories about particular trays. The narrator moves from seeing undifferentiated green to recognizing varieties and a need for water.

distractorRationale.d: By noon the narrator can distinguish three varieties.
distractorRationale.a: The narrator becomes absorbed and leaves later.
distractorRationale.c: Ben continues to sign the ledger.
